items.question: What auspicious melaka sthana has been told and heard by you as desired?
items.inference: The auspicious melaka sthana is the told and heard desired abode.
uncertainties: Exact case roles and sandhi are not fully recoverable from the isolated verse.
items.plain_english: The auspicious union-place abode has been told; it has been heard by you and is desired.
